# SYNTHESIZED transition, not a recording: opencode turn in progress -> finished
# composer. The frames are opencode v1.18.32's composer rebuilt from its own source
# (packages/tui/src/component/prompt/index.tsx). They replace frames written as
# `esc to interrupt` over a bare `> ` composer: that spelling is in none of the
# releases sampled from v0.0.2 to v1.18.32, and only v0.0 drew a bare `>`. Only the
# timing is constructed, and it is the earlier fixture's: the
# status row shows the spinner and `esc interrupt` while the turn runs and the key hints
# alone once it ends, and the composer reads as idle with visible_idle, so the tail
# publishes Idle once and stays there: the honest expectation is a clean
# Working-to-Idle handoff with no Working-to-Idle-to-Working flap on a stable tail.
agent: opencode
